new_jobs.title: Head of AI - Principal Applied AI Engineer (LLM Systems)
new_jobs.jd: **【About us】** Raccoon AI is an emerging generative AI company. Our core product automates customer service messaging for e\-commerce and online platforms, resolving 50 to 80% of conversations instantly. The standard this role is accountable for is an autonomous agent that resolves real customer conversations end to end, at production quality and production volume, across languages. **【About the Role】** This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who arrived at production work through research. The foundation is a first\-principles understanding of how these models actually work. When behavior breaks, that understanding is what turns guesswork into an explainable engineering decision, reasoning through tokenization, attention, sampling, context window, and training distribution. It is also what model strategy rests on: whether to stay on hosted models or invest in fine\-tuning and self\-training, a decision this role owns and defends with data, cost, and technical trade\-offs. What this role is hired for is that depth pointed at a product. Model selection and prompt tuning are the starting point, not the substance. The substance is the design of AI behavior for specific business contexts: defining what the agent is permitted to do in a given scenario, where its boundaries sit, when it must refuse or escalate, how it handles ambiguity and adversarial input, and how each of those decisions is measured. Scenario\-level configuration of this kind determines whether the product is trusted in production. The expected pattern of work is to read the literature, form a position, run the experiment, and land the result in production. Direction is set by this role rather than handed to it. **【What You'll Do】** * Own the behavioral design of the production AI agent: scope, permissions, guardrails, refusal and escalation policy, and failure handling for each business scenario * Own LLM system architecture end to end, covering prompting, RAG retrieval, multi\-agent tool use, and evaluation methodology * Own model strategy, including hosted, fine\-tuned, and self\-trained options, argued from data and cost, with multi\-vendor abstraction where it is warranted * Debug model behavior from first principles: tokenization, attention, sampling, and context window effects * Build quantifiable evaluation and observability so that every prompt or model change is measured before release * Track frontier research and convert it into product decisions * Raise the LLM engineering capability of the wider team **【What You'll Need】** * A master's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Management, or an AI\-related field, from a leading domestic or international university. A thesis in LLM or NLP is a strong signal. Equivalent depth demonstrated through production AI model work will also be considered. * 5\+ years in software or ML engineering, including 2 to 3 years building production LLM or GenAI systems * Experience in both a large engineering organization and an early\-stage startup. This role requires the engineering discipline of the former and the ownership of the latter.\\ * Deep understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, pretraining, fine\-tuning, RLHF, and decoding strategies\\ * A research foundation that has been carried into production. A thesis, publications, or a record of reproducing and extending papers, followed by shipped systems built on that understanding. * Self\-direction. This role defines its own problems and priorities rather than waiting for specification. * The ability to explain model behavior and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders and influence decisions with them **【Nice to Have】** * Fine\-tuning, training, or distillation experience (LoRA, SFT, RLHF/DPO) * Multilingual and CJK NLP experience * Inference optimization and inference serving * Experience building LLM evaluation and observability systems * Experience building or operating autonomous customer service agents (Intercom Fin, Sierra, Decagon, or equivalent)

new_jobs.jd: **About VicOne** VicOne is a leader in Physical AI cybersecurity, protecting AI\-powered vehicles and robotic systems. You'll work on real\-world attack research, large\-scale telemetry data, and a fast\-evolving AI toolchain. Radeis and Rthena are the only products of their kind, backed by VicOne LabR7, and serving real robot OEM customers globally.

new_jobs.jd: **資深醫療影像 AI 工程師（Senior Medical Imaging AI Engineer）** 全職 ｜ 台北市南港區 ｜ 直接向技術長（CTO）匯報 職務簡介 神瑞人工智慧（DeepRad.AI）是一家以預防醫學為核心的醫療影像 AI 公司，由醫師與工程團隊共同創辦，產品已在醫學中心體系實際部署，並同步推進日本與美國的法規與市場佈局；研究成果發表於 Nature Communications。 **這個職位的成就** ：你交付的不是一個模型指標，而是一個通過法規審查、跑在醫院機房裡、被醫師每天使用的臨床工具。你將擁有從資料策略、模型設計、驗證確效到上線監控的完整話語權。 **如何與組織連結** ：你會站在臨床、法規與商務的交會點——與放射科醫師定義有臨床意義的問題，與法規團隊產出送審證據，並確保模型效能撐得起醫院端的價值主張。 研發方向 * 胸腹部 CT 的多病灶偵測與量化（肺部病灶、血管鈣化、骨質、肝臟脂肪） * 腦部 MRI 之神經退化與認知功能相關影像分析 * 多模態學習：影像結合結構化臨床資料 * 醫療影像基礎模型（foundation model）的微調與應用 責任 * 主導 3D 醫療影像模型的設計、訓練與優化，持續改善敏感度與偽陽性率之間的臨床權衡。 * 與臨床合作單位共同定義標註規範，處理多院所、多機型的影像異質性，建立可重現的資料流程與品質稽核機制。 * **將模型落地至臨床環境** ：設計並維護 DICOM／PACS 整合、推論服務與部署架構，在醫院實際硬體條件下達成穩定的延遲與可用性目標。 * 建立上線後監控機制，追蹤資料漂移與效能衰退，設計告警與再訓練決策流程。 * 依 SaMD 品質系統要求執行軟體驗證與確效（V\&V），產出法規等級文件，支援 TFDA 與 FDA 510(k) 送件。 * 進行程式碼審查、建立工程規範，並指導較資淺的工程師。 資格 * 資工、電機、生醫工程、醫學物理或相關領域碩士以上（具同等實務經驗者亦歡迎）。 * 3 年以上深度學習實務經驗， **具醫學影像處理 AI 經驗者優先** 。 * 精通 Python 與 PyTorch（或 TensorFlow），具 3D 卷積網路、分割架構或 Transformer 視覺模型實作經驗。 * 熟悉 DICOM 標準與醫療影像前處理，理解 PACS／RIS 介接概念。 * 具備模型從研究原型推進至產品化部署的完整經驗（容器化、CI/CD、推論優化）。 * 能以臨床語言評估模型（ROC/AUC、敏感度／特異度、FROC、Dice），並理解其臨床意義與侷限。 * 傑出的口語及書寫溝通技能，中英文皆能作為工作語言。 **加分** * **具生物統計背景** ：能規劃臨床驗證研究的統計分析與樣本數估算。 * **具放射醫學背景或影像判讀訓練** ：理解臨床判讀流程與報告邏輯。 * 醫療器材軟體（SaMD）法規開發經驗：IEC 62304、ISO 13485、V\&V 文件產出。 * MLOps 實務：模型版本控管、實驗追蹤、資料漂移監控。 * 於 MICCAI／RSNA／CVPR 或頂尖期刊發表醫療影像研究。 我們提供 * 真實的臨床影響力：你的模型進入醫院場域服務病人，而非停在論文與 Demo。 * 精簡團隊中的完整技術話語權，直接向 CTO 匯報。 * 參與日本與美國法規送審，累積難以複製的跨國 SaMD 經驗。 * 具競爭力的薪酬與員工認股權，依經驗核敘。 應徵方式 履歷（附上你最引以為傲的一個醫療影像專案說明）寄至 **roger@deepradai.com** ， 或於 LinkedIn 私訊 Roger Chang。 我們歡迎不同背景與職涯路徑的申請者。若你符合大部分條件但並非全部，仍鼓勵提出申請。秘訣：提供職務簡介、職位成就為何，以及如何使此職務符合組織整體。
